description: Ask Follow On Tours for a quote on a traveller's behalf. Use after you have found a suitable trip with list_tours or list_golf_trips (or for any other cricket or golf trip — describe it in `trip`). Follow On Tours emails the traveller to confirm the request is theirs; nothing reaches Follow On Tours, and nothing is booked or charged, until the traveller taps the link in that email. Only send details the traveller has given you and agreed to share. This tool never returns a price: quotes come from Follow On Tours directly.

budgetBand.description: The traveller's rough budget per person, only if they have said. Never a price from Follow On Tours.

email.description: The traveller's own email address. The confirmation goes here.

groundPreference.description: Which grounds, matches or courses matter most, in the traveller's words.

nights.description: How many nights away, if the traveller has said.

preferredDates.description: Dates or matches, in the traveller's words.

trip.description: The trip name or page URL from list_tours / list_golf_trips, or a short description.

name: request_quote
